verdict.rationale: USCIS is a government service with a developer platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only REST-style Torch APIs (Case Status, FOIA) with developer accounts, keys and a sandbox. Those are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, and probes show agent-oriented paths such as llms.txt returning 403. No official MCP server is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
